explication: Apache Maven is a POM-centered project management and build tool. A user invokes it through the CLI; Maven establishes an execution session, resolves project and artifact information, and can execute build plugins. The README also identifies reporting and documentation as product capabilities, though their implementations are not represented in the supplied tree. Connections below are limited to relationships explicitly documented by the README or visible in the sampled excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; several internal runtime links remain unverified.
